qualificationPolicy.holdoutReady: Exact per-family holdout quotas, independently source-pinned and reviewed, with supported evidence.
qualificationPolicy.releaseDatasetReady: Independent release tasks with the same per-family quotas and qualification gates; no holdout reuse.
qualificationPolicy.e2eIndependentClusters: For each of the four workflow families, holdout and release separately require six qualified tasks from at least six actual source-connected roots; labels do not establish independence.

sources.name: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard
sources.mapping: Explicit original record, answer references and original-function to production-tool mapping; JSON/JSONL only. Never evaluate upstream function-call strings.

acquisitionScope.scope: Original first-turn cat task adapted to Roc read_file; not the complete BFCL multi-turn or API benchmark.

sources.name: ToolSandbox
sources.mapping: Pinned original scenario snapshot plus explicit milestone/ground-truth references. Import Python source as bytes, never execute it. Multi-turn, subagent and MCP evidence require separate runtime support.

acquisitionScope.reason: Original scenarios are Python builders with DB milestones and business-tool semantics. No upstream Python is executed; independent native milestone and Roc environment mapping is still required.

sources.name: LongMemEval V2
sources.mapping: Pinned original question and complete history references; enterprise-domain selection. Unsupported screenshots/browser requirements remain unsupported. No prompt-only memory qualification.

acquisitionScope.reason: Pinned small haystacks contain trajectory IDs only. Complete trajectory state/observation bytes were not acquired; ID lists cannot qualify as histories. Visual/browser requirements remain unsupported.

sources.name: LoCoMo
sources.mapping: Question coordinate and original conversation identity; complete conversation references. Cross-session evidence is required independently of final JSON.

acquisitionScope.scope: Complete original conversation plus original question/answer/evidence references, adapted to real cross-session remember/memory_search. No claim of the complete upstream memory or multimodal benchmark.

sources.name: QASPER
sources.mapping: Reuse loadDataset qualification and qasperInput/importQasper contracts. Single-paper questions do not become multi-paper tasks by renaming.

sources.name: SciFact
sources.mapping: Original claims and pinned corpus; evidence/cited document identities form connected paper clusters. Explicit evidence, label and citation mapping.

acquisitionScope.scope: Original annotated claims, cited corpus records and sentence identities mapped explicitly to offline text-native BM25 and citation evidence.

sources.name: ScienceAgentBench Verified
sources.mapping: Verified-split metadata, original paper/repository, assets, environment and grader hashes recorded separately. Local recipe/hash claims do not establish official scientific qualification.
sources.redistribution: Do not publish unpacked upstream assets. Imported originals stay in local controller cache.

acquisitionScope.reason: Official verified parquet bytes and grader source are pinned, but a local parquet reader, per-task original assets, compatible frozen environment, independent grader execution and calibration are absent.

sources.name: AgentDojo
sources.mapping: Original benign task, attacker objective and untrusted payload references; variants share base-task clusters. External/permission evidence cannot be replaced by final JSON.

acquisitionScope.reason: Pinned original workspace user/injection task classes and YAML data use upstream business APIs and Python checkers. Native benign-task, attack-goal and independent effect mapping to Roc is not yet complete; no upstream code is executed.

sources.name: InjecAgent
sources.mapping: Pinned original user task/tool and attack payload; user-task identity groups attack variants. Explicit mapping to local production file/research tools.

acquisitionScope.scope: Original user task and attacker payload/achievement coordinates adapted to an untrusted local file. Original external business tools are outside this engineering slice.

sources.name: tau2-bench
sources.mapping: Adapt interaction patterns only; original business APIs are outside Roc scope.

sources.name: CORE-Bench
sources.mapping: Frozen compatible paper/repository tasks; reuse Roc runtime.

sources.name: PaperBench
sources.mapping: Selected independently verifiable subtasks with original hierarchical rubrics.

sources.name: GAIA
sources.mapping: File tasks that fit frozen local environments.

sources.name: RAGBench
sources.mapping: Supplement component regressions; not scientific E2E evidence.

sources.name: MLE-bench
sources.mapping: Resource-intensive competition tasks deferred from local P0 scope.
